title: Online registration
intro: The tasks that only make sense once your place, course, and modules are actually confirmed. Complete these to finish registering for 2026-27.

tasks.title: Academic programme details
tasks.desc: Confirms the details of your specific academic programme — course structure and department.

tasks.title: Module choice
tasks.desc: Choose your optional or elective modules.

tasks.title: Course details confirmation
tasks.desc: The finalised details of your specific course, confirmed once your place and results are in.

tasks.title: Semester dates, calendar & attendance
tasks.desc: Term dates, the academic calendar, and the University's attendance-monitoring policy.

tasks.title: IT security & digital skills training
tasks.desc: Mandatory cyber-security awareness training and a guide to the software and apps you'll use day to day.

tasks.title: UCard photo & issue
tasks.desc: Submit your photo and get your UCard issued — your student ID, library card, and building pass.

tasks.title: UK bank account details
tasks.desc: Set up a UK bank account — needed to receive maintenance loan payments.

tasks.title: Disability declaration
tasks.desc: Tell us about any disability or support needs now you're registered, so support can be put in place.

tasks.title: Health & safety induction
tasks.desc: Health & safety essentials, given once you're on campus or about to be.

tasks.title: Arrange fee payment
tasks.desc: Arrange how you'll actually pay your confirmed tuition fees — the final step after the earlier fee status check.

tasks.title: Electoral registration
tasks.desc: Encourages electoral (voter) registration at your term-time address.

tasks.title: Students' Union membership
tasks.desc: Introduces the Students' Union and lets you opt out of automatic SU membership.

tasks.title: Complete online registration
tasks.desc: The core action itself — confirming your registration, done once a year.
